title: The 10th lord is in a kendra or trikona

text.en: The lord of the 10th house sits in a kendra or trikona, which classical texts read as support for career and standing.
text.impact: In everyday terms, work tends to go somewhere. Your efforts get noticed, and responsibility comes to you in the natural course rather than by struggle.

title: The 10th lord is in the 6th, 8th or 12th house

text.en: The lord of the 10th house sits in a dusthana (the 6th, 8th or 12th), which classical texts read as strain on career and standing.
text.impact: This often shows as a career that takes a less direct route: changes of job or field, stretches of working behind the scenes, or success that arrives later than it does for others. Many people with this placement do well in service, healthcare, research or work abroad. Persistence through the indirect stretches is what makes it come good.

title: The 10th lord is exalted, in moolatrikona or in its own sign

text.en: The lord of the 10th house is exalted, in moolatrikona or in its own sign, and able to give its results fully.
text.impact: This usually shows as steady standing at work. What you take up, you tend to hold, and your reputation grows with time rather than fading.

title: The 10th lord is debilitated

text.en: The lord of the 10th house is debilitated, which classical texts read as difficulty with career and standing, unless the debilitation is cancelled.
text.impact: Work can ask more effort of you than it seems to of others, or start slowly before it settles. This speaks about the pace of the climb, not about your ability.

text.impact: The difficulty is lifted. A slow or awkward start at work tends to turn around, and the effort put in during the lean years is usually what carries you afterwards.

text.en: The lord of the 10th house is combust, too close to the Sun, which is traditionally held to weaken it.
text.impact: Your work may get less recognition than it deserves for a while, or your role may sit in someone else's shadow. Keeping a record of what you contribute helps.

title: The 9th and 10th lords are related (dharma-karmadhipati yoga)

text.en: The lords of the 9th and 10th houses are related by conjunction, mutual aspect or exchange: the dharma-karmadhipati yoga, classically among the strongest combinations for career.
text.impact: One of the better combinations for working life. What you believe in and what you do for a living tend to point the same way, and openings often come through mentors, teachers or people who take an interest in you.
